name: THE FIDDLER
note: Doc 07 #11. 'The Nugget. Tuned to the flat piano, therefore flat. Corrects first in Act IV.' He stands by the piano with his fiddle. HIS BARKS ARE ALL PLAYING (doc 07: 'mostly just playing'): none is a spoken line, so his file has none, and what doc 07 writes for R_BORDERS_MOTT, R_DEAD and R_TRUTH is music: his `barkCues` and Room 33's R33-FIDDLER (errata 116). While he is in the room the Nugget's music carries his fiddle (manifest, `whenPresent`). Doc 22: he idles in time with the bar grid.
barksNote: Doc 07 §11 writes him three barks and all three are playing, not words, so he has no balloon. Two are `barkCues`, played on approach as a bark is: R_BORDERS_MOTT, 'something faster'; R_DEAD, 'the passing tune'. The third, R_TRUTH, happens in F2 wherever Thad is, and is Room 33's (R33-FIDDLER on the tuning arc's clock). Errata 116.

sprite.frameNote: HE KEEPS TIME WITH THE PIANO (doc 22: the fiddler idles in time with the musical bar grid; errata 118): `keepsTime` reads the Nugget bed's own position at its tempo, 152, so 0, the bow out at the start of the stroke, and 1, drawn across to its end, alternate once a beat, and a break comes every twelve bars (18.95 s), on a bar line. 2 mid-stroke, for a busier passage in the second break; 3 TUNE, the fiddle at his chest, a peg turned -- the first break; 4 TALK, fiddle and bow lowered.
